subject.title: fix(telegram): suppress failure fallback when source delivery is message-tool-only

question: Which open Telegram message-tool-only fallback PR should be the canonical landing path after current-main fallback changes?
rationale: Both open PRs target the same linked bug, and choosing between this member branch and the proof-sufficient sibling affects message-delivery behavior and duplicate cleanup.

options.title: Prefer the proof-sufficient sibling
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90095 or an equivalent rebased patch as canonical because it has stronger real-behavior proof and the narrower non-error guard shape.

options.title: Refresh this PR as canonical
options.body: Ask for this branch to be rebased onto current main and rechecked against the final-answer fallback changes before selecting it.

options.title: Request native Telegram proof first
options.body: Pause both candidates until a Telegram Desktop or equivalent live replay confirms the fallback bubble is absent in the configured group flow.
